label: Nothing Phone (2) smartphone
description: Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 phone with a 5G modem and dual-band Wi-Fi 6 only (802.11ax, 2.4 and 5 GHz, 2x2 MIMO); it has no 6 GHz radio, so no Wi-Fi 6E or 7.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz) — no 6 GHz, no Wi-Fi 6E/7 despite the Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 platform. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz only, no mmWave; LTE Cat 20 fallback. USB-C is USB 2.0 with Ethernet adapter support (usb0) but real throughput is ~100M. Near-AOSP Nothing OS is handy for reproducible Wi-Fi client behaviour.
